content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to the use of open-source tools and decentralized payment systems to create online stores that are independent of traditional payment gateways. This approach matters because it allows digital creators to maintain ownership and control over their stores, without relying on third-party services that may be restricted or unavailable in their region. By using crypto payments, creators can reach a global audience and receive payments without the need for intermediaries.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure typically involves the use of static site generators like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. For crypto payments, services like NOWPayments provide automatic on-chain payment verification, allowing creators to receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies. This architecture is designed to be scalable, secure, and easy to maintain, giving creators the freedom to focus on their products and customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is built for digital creators who are looking for a reliable and independent way to sell their design assets online. This includes creators of ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, who are often restricted by traditional payment systems. By using sovereign commerce infrastructure, these creators can take control of their online stores, reach a global audience, and receive payments without the need for intermediaries. This approach is particularly useful for creators in regions where traditional payment systems are unavailable or restricted.
Build a reliable online store with crypto payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of sovereign commerce infrastructure work together to provide a seamless and secure payment experience for creators and their customers. These components include hosting, backend logic, order storage, and crypto payment verification. By integrating these components, creators can build online stores that are scalable, secure, and easy to maintain. Additionally, the use of open-source tools and decentralized payment systems ensures that creators maintain ownership and control over their stores, without relying on third-party services.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure today, creators can start by choosing a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. They can then integrate a payment service like NOWPayments, which provides automatic on-chain payment verification. By following these steps, creators can build online stores that are independent, scalable, and secure, and start selling their design assets with crypto payments.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Take control of your digital products and sales.

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, offers a convenient and cost-effective way for digital creators to get started with sovereign commerce infrastructure. By investing in this kit, creators can take the first step towards building a reliable and independent online store that accepts crypto payments.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: choose a hosting platform, select a backend logic tool, integrate a payment service, set up order storage, and configure crypto payment verification. Additionally, ensure that your store is scalable, secure, and easy to maintain, and that you have access to all the tools and resources you need to succeed. With the right approach, you can build a thriving online store that reaches a global audience and accepts crypto payments.
